name: language-tutor
description: A language tutor that lives in Claude Code: spaced review, quizzes, rubric grading, an error ledger and placement, for any language you name

tutor_language.title: Language you are learning
tutor_language.description: The language the tutor teaches, such as Italian. Leave blank to keep the tutor off.

tutor_store.title: Learner store folder
tutor_store.description: A folder you own, where the tutor keeps your words, reviews, mistakes and level, one subfolder per language. It survives a plugin uninstall. Leave blank and the tutor stores nothing.

tutor_remind.title: Remind me when words are due
tutor_remind.description: Each new session opens with one line naming the words due. Off by default.
